mapper.update: /*buyer.mpso.delyReturnPrhdInsert*/ INSERT INTO ICOMPRHD ( BUYER , PR_NO , STATUS , ADD_DATE , ADD_TIME , CHANGE_DATE , CHANGE_TIME , NOTIFY , PR_SUBJECT , PURCHASER_DEPT , RECV_FLAG , RETURN_REASON , ACCOUNT_TYPE , INVESTMENT_NO , SAMPLE_FLAG , DELY_TO_LOCATION , REMARK , ADD_USER_ID , ADD_USER_NAME , ADD_USER_TEL , ADD_USER_DEPT , CHANGE_USER_ID , CHANGE_USER_NAME , CHANGE_USER_TEL , CHANGE_USER_DEPT , SIGN_DATE , SIGN_PERSON_ID , SAVE_FLAG , IMAGE_KEY , DOC_TYPE ) (SELECT PH.BUYER , #{DOC_NO } AS PR_NO , 'C' AS STATUS , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AS ADD_DATE , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS') AS ADD_TIME , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AS CHANGE_DATE , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS') AS CHANGE_TIME , PH.NOTIFY , PH.PR_SUBJECT , PH.PURCHASER_DEPT , 'GA' AS RECV_FLAG , PH.RETURN_REASON , PH.ACCOUNT_TYPE , PH.INVESTMENT_NO , PH.SAMPLE_FLAG , PH.DELY_TO_LOCATION , PH.REMARK , PH.ADD_USER_ID , PH.ADD_USER_NAME , PH.ADD_USER_TEL , PH.ADD_USER_DEPT , PH.CHANGE_USER_ID , PH.CHANGE_USER_NAME , PH.CHANGE_USER_TEL , PH.CHANGE_USER_DEPT , PH.SIGN_DATE , PH.SIGN_PERSON_ID , 'PR' AS SAVE_FLAG , PH.IMAGE_KEY , PH.DOC_TYPE FROM ICOMPRHD PH , ICOMPRDT PR , ICOMPRDT PR_R WHERE 1 = 1 AND PR_R.BUYER = #{BUYER} AND PR_R.PR_NO = #{DOC_NO} AND PH.BUYER = PR.BUYER AND PH.PR_NO = PR.PR_NO AND PR.BUYER = PR_R.BUYER AND PR.PR_NO = PR_R.ORI_PR_NO AND PR.PR_SEQ = PR_R.ORI_PR_SEQ AND ROWNUM = 1 )

/*buyer.mpso.delyReturnTrxlInsert*/ INSERT INTO EAI.IF_COWAY_PR_SEND ( BUYER, PR_NO, PR_SEQ, I_AFNAM, I_MBLNR, I_STATUS, BUKRS, ORGEH, STEXT, PERNR, ENAME, HDATE, ZGISU, NEWCK, ZCODE, MATNR, MAKTX, GIMENGE, MEINS, GUBUN, ERSDA, ERNAM, LAEDA, AENAM, YUMUSANG, DRSITE, DRCP, DPOINT, POST_CODE1, CITY1, STREET, TEL_NUMBER, MOB_NUMBER, IF_DATE, IF_TIME, IF_FLAG, REG_DATE, MBLNR ) SELECT DISTINCT A.BUYER, A.PR_NO, A.PR_SEQ, B.LEGACY_USER_ID AS I_AFNAM, A.REF_PR_NO AS I_MBLNR, CASE WHEN A.STATUS = 'D' THEN 'X' ELSE 'R' END AS I_STATUS, '2000' AS BUKRS, CASE WHEN K.DEPT_TYPE = '70' THEN K.UP_DEPT_CODE ELSE D.DEPARTMENT END AS ORGEH, SUBSTRB(C.TEXT1,1,40) AS STEXT, D.LEGACY_USER_ID AS PERNR, SUBSTRB(D.USER_NAME_LOC,1,40) AS ENAME, D.REG_DATE AS HDATE, D.BLD_2 AS ZGISU, 'N' AS NEWCK, F_SPLIT(A.MG_NOTE,',', 1) AS ZCODE, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS MATNR, SUBSTRB(A.DESCRIPTION, 1, 40) AS MAKTX, A.TARGET_QTY AS GIMENGE, A.UNIT_MEASURE AS MEINS, 'N' AS GUBUN, A.ADD_DATE AS ERSDA, SUBSTRB(A.ADD_USER_NAME,1,12) AS ERNAM, A.CHANGE_DATE AS LAEDA, SUBSTRB(A.CHANGE_USER_NAME,1,12) AS AENAM, F_SPLIT(A.MG_NOTE,',', 2) AS YUMUSANG, CASE WHEN A.BUYER = 'KRCOWA0002' THEN 'N' ELSE CASE WHEN P.POINT_AMT IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END END AS DRSITE, CASE WHEN A.BUYER = 'KRCOWA0002' THEN 'C' ELSE CASE WHEN P.POINT_AMT IS NULL THEN 'C' ELSE 'P' END END AS DRCP, CASE WHEN A.BUYER = 'KRCOWA0002' THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN P.POINT_AMT IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE P.POINT_AMT END END AS DPOINT, SUBSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION,1,7) AS POST_CODE1, CASE WHEN INSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION,'리 ') > 0 THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION,8, INSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION,'리 ') -7 )) WHEN INSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION,'동 ') > 0 THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION,8, INSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION,'동 ') -7 )) WHEN INSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION,'면 ') > 0 THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION,8, INSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION,'면 ') -7 )) WHEN INSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION,'읍 ') > 0 THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION,8, INSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION,'읍 ') -7 )) WHEN INSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION,'구 ') > 0 THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION,8, INSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION,'구 ') -7 )) WHEN INSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION,'군 ') > 0 THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION,8, INSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION,'군 ') -7 )) WHEN INSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION,'시 ') > 0 THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION,8, INSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION,'시 ') -7 )) WHEN INSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION,'도 ') > 0 THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION,8, INSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION,'도 ') -7 )) END AS CITY1, CASE WHEN INSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION,'리 ') > 0 THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION,INSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION,'리 ') + 1, LENGTH(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION) )) WHEN INSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION,'동 ') > 0 THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION,INSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION,'동 ') + 1, LENGTH(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION) )) WHEN INSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION,'면 ') > 0 THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION,INSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION,'면 ') + 1, LENGTH(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION) )) WHEN INSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION,'읍 ') > 0 THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION,INSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION,'읍 ') + 1, LENGTH(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION) )) WHEN INSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION,'구 ') > 0 THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION,INSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION,'구 ') + 1, LENGTH(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION) )) WHEN INSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION,'군 ') > 0 THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION,INSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION,'군 ') + 1, LENGTH(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION) )) WHEN INSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION,'시 ') > 0 THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION,INSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION,'시 ') + 1, LENGTH(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION) )) WHEN INSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION,'도 ') > 0 THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION,INSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION,'도 ') + 1, LENGTH(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION) )) END AS STREET, E.CHANGE_USER_TEL AS TEL_NUMBER, ' ' AS MOB_NUMBER, ' ' AS IF_DATE, ' ' AS IF_TIME, 'N' AS IF_FLAG, SYSDATE AS REG_DATE, (SELECT REF_PR_NO FROM ICOMPRDT WHERE BUYER = A.BUYER AND PR_NO = A.ORI_PR_NO AND PR_SEQ = A.ORI_PR_SEQ ) AS MBLNR FROM ICOMPRDT A INNER JOIN ICOMPRHD E ON (1 = 1 AND E.BUYER = A.BUYER AND E.PR_NO = A.PR_NO AND E.STATUS IN ('C','R') ) INNER JOIN ICOMLUSR B ON (1 = 1 AND B.USER_ID = A.ADD_USER_ID ) INNER JOIN ICOMLUSR D ON (1 = 1 AND D.USER_ID = A.REQ_USER_ID ) INNER JOIN ICOMCOD2 C ON (1 = 1 AND C.TYPE = 'C001' AND C.COMPANY_CODE = D.COM_CODE AND C.CODE = D.DEPARTMENT AND C.FLAG = 'Y' ) INNER JOIN COWAY_HR_ORGDATA K ON (1 = 1 AND K.DEPT_CODE = D.DEPARTMENT ) LEFT OUTER JOIN COWAY_POINT_HISTORY P ON (1 = 1 AND P.BUYER = A.BUYER AND P.PR_NO = A.PR_NO AND P.PR_SEQ = A.PR_NO ) WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.BUYER = #{st_buyer } AND A.PR_NO = #{DOC_NO } AND A.RECV_FLAG = 'GA' AND A.SAVE_FLAG = 'PR' AND A.MG_NOTE IS NOT NULL AND A.STATUS IN ('C','R') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 'X' FROM IF_PROGRESS WHERE BUYER = A.BUYER AND GUBUN = 'XX' AND LEGACY_NO = A.PR_NO AND REMARK = 'ZMM_GSYS_REREQUEST_CHECK')

SELECT COUNT(PR_SEQ)+1 AS DOC_SEQ FROM ICOMPRDT WHERE BUYER = #{st_buyer } and PR_NO = #{DOC_NO }
/*buyer.mpso.delyReturnPrdtInsert*/ INSERT INTO ICOMPRDT ( BUYER , PR_NO , PR_SEQ , STATUS , ADD_DATE , ADD_TIME , CHANGE_DATE , CHANGE_TIME , BUYER_ITEM_NO , SELLER_ITEM_NO , SELLER , CATALOG_ITEM_NO , ITEM_TYPE , DESCRIPTION , SPECIFICATION , HS_NO , MAKER_CODE , MAKER_NAME , MAKER_PART_NO , IMAGE_KEY , UNIT_MEASURE , CUR , RD_DATE , TARGET_PRICE , TARGET_QTY , DELY_TO_LOCATION , ACCOUNT_TYPE , BUDGET_DEPT , RECV_FLAG , PURCHASING_AGENT_FLAG , PO_QTY , RETURN_REASON , REMARK , RFQ_NO , RFQ_COUNT , RFQ_SEQ , SAMPLE_FLAG , COMPLETE_MARK , RECV_QTY , GR_QTY , CTR_QTY , PURCHASER_ID , SUB_PURCHASER_ID , PURCHASER_DEPT , SAVE_FLAG , ADD_USER_ID , ADD_USER_NAME , ADD_USER_TEL , ADD_USER_DEPT , CHANGE_USER_ID , CHANGE_USER_NAME , CHANGE_USER_TEL , CHANGE_USER_DEPT , REF_NO , REF_SEQ , REF_PR_NO , REF_ADD_USER_ID , REQ_USER_ID , REQ_DEPT , AGENT , CONTRACT_NO , CONTRACT_SEQ , LEGACY_PO_NO , LEGACY_PO_SEQ , REF_IF_NO , LIST_PRICE , DOC_TYPE , REQ_USER_INFO , PLAN_AMT_FLAG , BYIT_COMORG_CODE , PROCESS_TYPE , CATEG_ID , MG_CODE , MG_NOTE , ORI_PR_NO , ORI_PR_SEQ ) (SELECT PR.BUYER , #{DOC_NO } AS PR_NO , TO_CHAR(#{DOC_SEQ }, 'FM000000') AS PR_SEQ , 'C' AS STATUS , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AS ADD_DATE , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS') AS ADD_TIME , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AS CHANGE_DATE , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS') AS CHANGE_TIME , PR.BUYER_ITEM_NO , PR.SELLER_ITEM_NO , PR.SELLER , PR.CATALOG_ITEM_NO , PR.ITEM_TYPE , PR.DESCRIPTION , PR.SPECIFICATION , PR.HS_NO , PR.MAKER_CODE , PR.MAKER_NAME , PR.MAKER_PART_NO , PR.IMAGE_KEY , PR.UNIT_MEASURE , PR.CUR , PR.RD_DATE , GR.UNIT_PRICE AS TARGET_PRICE , #{st_return_qty } * -1 AS TARGET_QTY , PR.DELY_TO_LOCATION , PR.ACCOUNT_TYPE , PR.BUDGET_DEPT , 'GA' AS RECV_FLAG , PR.PURCHASING_AGENT_FLAG , 0 , PR.RETURN_REASON , #{st_return_remark } AS REMARK , PR.RFQ_NO , PR.RFQ_COUNT , PR.RFQ_SEQ , PR.SAMPLE_FLAG , PR.COMPLETE_MARK , #{st_return_qty } * -1 , 0 , PR.CTR_QTY * -1 , PR.PURCHASER_ID , PR.SUB_PURCHASER_ID , PR.PURCHASER_DEPT , 'PR' AS SAVE_FLAG , PR.ADD_USER_ID , PR.ADD_USER_NAME , PR.ADD_USER_TEL , PR.ADD_USER_DEPT , PR.CHANGE_USER_ID , PR.CHANGE_USER_NAME , PR.CHANGE_USER_TEL , PR.CHANGE_USER_DEPT , PR.REF_NO , PR.REF_SEQ , #{I_REMBLNR} , PR.REF_ADD_USER_ID , #{st_req_user_id} , PR.REQ_DEPT , PR.AGENT , PR.CONTRACT_NO , PR.CONTRACT_SEQ , '' , '' , PR.REF_IF_NO , PR.LIST_PRICE , PR.DOC_TYPE , PR.REQ_USER_INFO , PR.PLAN_AMT_FLAG , PR.BYIT_COMORG_CODE , PR.PROCESS_TYPE , PR.CATEG_ID , PR.MG_CODE , #{st_mg_note} , #{st_lis_pr_no } AS ORI_PR_NO , #{st_lis_pr_seq } AS ORI_PR_SEQ FROM ICOMPRDT PR , ICOMPODT PO , ICOMGRDT GR WHERE 1 = 1 AND PR.BUYER = PO.BUYER AND PR.PR_NO = PO.PR_NO AND PR.PR_SEQ = PO.PR_SEQ AND PO.BUYER = GR.BUYER AND PO.PO_NO = GR.PO_NO AND PO.PO_SEQ = GR.PO_SEQ AND GR.BUYER = #{st_buyer } AND GR.GR_NO = #{st_gr_no } AND GR.GR_SEQ = #{st_gr_seq } )
mapper.select: /* buyer.mpso.delyReturnTrxlSelect */ SELECT I_MBLNR, I_AFNAM, I_STATUS, MBLNR, BUKRS, ORGEH, PERNR, ZCODE, LPAD(MATNR, 18, '0') AS MATNR, GIMENGE * -1 AS REMENGE, YUMUSANG FROM EAI.IF_COWAY_PR_SEND WHERE BUYER = #{BUYER} AND I_MBLNR = #{I_MBNLR}
